tasks: Search for 'wireless noise cancelling headphones', sort results by average customer rating, and add the top-rated item under $200 to my cart in quantity 1.
From my past orders, find the most recent purchase of 'paper towels' and reorder the exact same item and quantity.
Create a new wish list named 'Kitchen Upgrades 2025' and add the three best-selling air fryers under $150 to that list.
Update my default shipping address to '1234 Elm Street, Apt 5B, Springfield, IL 62704' and set it as the primary address for all future orders.
Find a Kindle eBook version of 'Atomic Habits' by James Clear, ensure the price is under $20, and purchase it to be delivered to my default Kindle device.
Search for 'USB-C charging cable 6ft', filter results to only show items with Prime eligible shipping and at least a 4-star rating, then add the cheapest option to my cart with quantity 2.

Locate my order for 'Instant Pot Duo 7-in-1' placed within the last 6 months and initiate a return request selecting 'Item defective or doesn't work' as the reason and requesting a refund to my original payment method.
Add a new payment method using the credit card number '4111 1111 1111 1111' with expiration '12/28' and CVV '123', set it as my default payment option, and remove my previous default credit card.
Subscribe to a 'household paper towels' product with at least a 4-star rating using Subscribe & Save, delivering a 12-roll pack every 2 months to my default address.

Search for 'LEGO Star Wars Millennium Falcon', open the product with the highest number of customer reviews, and post a 5-star review with the title 'Amazing build quality' and body text 'Took a full weekend to build and was worth every minute.'
Search for the channel 'Kurzgesagt – In a Nutshell' and subscribe to it from my authenticated YouTube account.
Like the most recent video uploaded by the channel 'Marques Brownlee' and add it to my existing playlist named 'Tech Reviews'.
Create a new public playlist titled 'Spanish Learning – Daily Practice' and add the top 5 search results for 'Spanish listening practice beginner' to that playlist.
Post a comment saying 'This breakdown was incredibly clear, thanks for the detailed explanation!' on the YouTube video with ID 'dQw4w9WgXcQ'.
Change the default playback quality setting for my account to always prefer 1080p HD when available on all devices.
Turn on subtitles in English (auto-generated if necessary) for the video with ID '3JZ_D3ELwOQ' and save that language as my preferred caption setting.

Upload a new video from my account with the title 'My 10-Minute Morning Workout Routine', description 'A quick no-equipment workout you can do at home every morning.', set its visibility to Unlisted, and add the tags 'fitness', 'home workout', and 'morning routine'.
Retrieve the last 20 videos I have watched and return them sorted by watch date in descending order along with their titles and channel names.
From my 'Watch Later' playlist, remove any video that is longer than 2 hours and return the remaining video titles.
Generate personalized video recommendations for my account based on my watch history but exclude any videos from channels I am already subscribed to and return the top 10 recommendations.
Create a new private repository named 'personal-notes' with a default main branch and initialize it with a README that contains the single heading '# Personal Notes Repository'.

In my existing repository 'website-portfolio', create a new branch named 'feature/dark-mode', add a new file at 'styles/dark-theme.css' with the content 'body { background-color: #121212; color: #f5f5f5; }', and open a pull request into 'main' with the title 'Add dark mode stylesheet' and a description explaining that it introduces a basic dark theme for all pages.

In the repository 'team-backend-api', open a pull request from branch 'bugfix/fix-timezone' into 'develop' and submit a review requesting changes with a comment on file 'src/utils/date.ts' line 42 saying 'Please handle UTC offsets explicitly instead of relying on the system timezone.'.

In my repository 'open-source-tool', create a new issue titled 'Add configuration file validation' with the body describing the feature request to validate 'config.yaml' on startup and include an unchecked task list with items 'Define JSON schema', 'Add validation step to startup', and 'Write tests for invalid configs'.

For the repository 'machine-learning-lab', enable GitHub Actions by adding a workflow file '.github/workflows/tests.yml' that runs on every push to the 'main' branch and executes 'pytest' with Python 3.10 on ubuntu-latest.
In the repository 'security-scanner', enable Dependabot security updates for npm by configuring a '.github/dependabot.yml' file that checks the root directory's 'package.json' weekly on Mondays.
In my repository 'blog-site', configure GitHub Pages to build from the 'gh-pages' branch and set the custom domain to 'blog.example.com'.

In the repository 'data-pipeline', add a new project board named 'Q1 Roadmap' with three columns titled 'Backlog', 'In Progress', and 'Done', and move existing open issues with the 'priority:high' label into the 'In Progress' column.

In my repository 'mobile-app', protect the 'main' branch by requiring at least two approving pull request reviews, disallowing direct pushes, and enabling status checks so that the workflow named 'CI' must pass before merging.

For the repository 'docs-hub', create a new release with the tag 'v2.0.0', title it 'Version 2.0.0 – Major Update', and set the release notes body to include a '## Breaking Changes' section listing that the old '/v1' API endpoints have been removed and the minimum supported Node.js version is now 18.
